# Bloody Developer

> Bloody Developer is a software engineering company based in Rourkela, Odisha, India. We build production-ready business software, custom web applications, enterprise ERP/CRM engines, and performance digital marketing funnels.

- Website: https://bloodydevelopers.vercel.app/
- HTML Sitemap: https://bloodydevelopers.vercel.app/sitemap
- XML Sitemap: https://bloodydevelopers.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- Contact: bloodydevelopers@gmail.com | +91 7684047069
- Headquarters: Rourkela, Odisha, India

## Production Software Products

- [Employee Attendance Management System](https://bloodydevelopers.vercel.app/products/attendance): Automated biometric time tracking, geo-fenced mobile check-ins, rotational shift rotas, and one-click payroll compliance.
- [Cafe Management POS Software](https://bloodydevelopers.vercel.app/products/cafe): High-velocity cloud POS, kitchen display system (KDS), real-time recipe ingredient depletion, and contactless QR ordering.
- [Task & Project Management Software](https://bloodydevelopers.vercel.app/products/task): Agile Kanban boards, Gantt timelines, automated sprint velocity tracking, and team collaboration.
- [School Management Software](https://bloodydevelopers.vercel.app/products/school): Complete institutional ERP for student dossiers, automated GPA calculation, online tuition fee billing, and parent communication.
- [Single Vendor E-Commerce Platform](https://bloodydevelopers.vercel.app/products/single-vendor): Blazing-fast headless online storefront with 0.4s load times, 1-click checkout, automated inventory tracking, and payment gateways.
- [Multi-Vendor Marketplace Platform](https://bloodydevelopers.vercel.app/products/multi-vendor): Scalable multi-seller commerce platform with dedicated vendor dashboards, tiered commissions, and payment escrow payouts.
- [Integrated CRM & ERP Solutions](https://bloodydevelopers.vercel.app/products/crm-erp): Centralized enterprise suite unifying multi-stage sales pipelines, double-entry financial ledgers, procurement, and predictive forecasting.

## Custom Software Engineering

- Web Design & Development: Expert, responsive, business-oriented websites and portals.
- Mobile Application Development: Android and cross-platform mobile apps with offline resilience.
- Custom Software Development: Tailored architectures solving complex operational bottlenecks.
- Custom CRM Development: Client management, deal pipeline tracking, and automated communications.
- ERP Development: Unified business operations, inventory, supply chain, and double-entry accounting.
- API Development & Integrations: Secure REST/GraphQL APIs, payment gateways, and hardware IoT sync.
